description: Defines interfaces for media transcoding control and callback mechanisms, including methods for starting, pausing, resuming, stopping sessions, and handling transcoding events and errors.

classes.name: TranscoderInterface
classes.description: Interface for controlling media transcoding sessions, including start, pause, resume, and stop operations.

classes.name: TranscoderCallbackInterface
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about transcoding session status, errors, progress, and resource loss.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new transcoding session with specified parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a transcoding session, with optional abandonment.

methods.name: onStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a session starts.

methods.name: onPaused
methods.description: Callback invoked when a session is paused.

methods.name: onResumed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a session is resumed.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Callback invoked when a session finishes.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Callback invoked when an error occurs during transcoding.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Callback for progress updates during transcoding.

methods.name: onHeartBeat
methods.description: Periodic callback to indicate active session.

methods.name: onResourceLost
methods.description: Callback when transcoding resources are temporarily unavailable.
